Norris Beauty Clinic’s content production policy regarding aesthetic medicine

Norris Beauty Clinic operates with the aim of disseminating accurate and easy-to-understand information to our readers about aesthetic medicine, such as medical diets (GLP-1 receptor agonists, fat freezing, fat-dissolving injections, liposuction, etc.) and double plastic surgery.

Cosmetic treatments such as medical diets and double plastic surgery are important themes that are closely related to each individual's health condition, constitution, cost, and schedule.

We create content with an emphasis on reliability, neutrality, and safety so that our readers can calmly make choices that are suitable for them and prepare for advance counseling.

■Basic policy for content production

■Production flow

At our media, we create content through the following process.

Production flow
  1. Search needs/concerns survey
  2. Configuration design (organizing comparison standards and points to note)
  3. Writing/editing/fact checking
  4. Regular updates to the latest prices and medical system

■Regarding reliability of information

When writing articles, we use the following public institutions and highly reliable information sources.

An example of reference data for this media
  • Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare(Medical advertising guidelines/Pharmaceuticals Act related information)
  • PMDA (Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency)
  • Japan Obesity Society・Japanese Society of Aesthetic Surgery (JSAS)Related academic societies such as
  • Consumer Affairs Agency(Related to the Specified Commercial Transactions Act and the Act on Premiums and Representations)
  • Official website information of each medical institution/pharmaceutical company

In addition, we regularly review information in response to price revisions, changes in clinic hours, updated guidelines, etc.

■Commitment to neutrality and transparency

Guaranteeing neutrality and objectivity
  • Specifies not only the benefits of each treatment but also side effects, risks, and downtime.
  • Presents points to note regarding total costs and cancellation regulations (cooling-off, etc.) for free medical treatment.
  • Do not use definitive expressions such as ``always'' or ``absolutely'' regarding changes or progress that vary from person to person.
  • Information is posted based on objective facts regardless of whether there is a partnership or not.

Explaining the difference between medical diet and self-help diet

Medical dieting is not self-effort such as dietary restrictions and exercise.fundamentally differentThis is an approach to weight loss.

It uses drugs and medical devices to approach appetite and fat cells, so it is a different method than self-help dieting.Aim for weight loss or partial size reductionIt is characterized by points.

Definition of medical diet, rebound mechanism, and three points regarding cost burden
  • Medical dieting is a medical procedure aimed at weight loss under the supervision of a doctor.
  • Self-help diets often lead to repeated rebounds due to a decline in basal metabolism and no change in the number of fat cells.
  • Difference between when medical diets are covered by insurance and when you have to pay the entire amount out of pocket

However, there are several types of medical diets, each with different mechanisms and costs.

In order to choose the treatment that is right for you, the starting point is to first understand how a medical diet differs from a self-help diet.

In this section, we will organize three points: the definition of medical diets, the mechanism by which rebounds tend to occur, and the cost burden mechanism.

Medical dieting is a medical procedure aimed at weight loss under the supervision of a doctor.

A medical diet is a diet aimed at weight loss under the guidance of a doctor and prescription/treatment.medical practiceIt is.

GLP-1 receptor agonistPrescriptions such as these and treatments using medical devices that act on fat cells are medical procedures that are performed under the consultation and instructions of a doctor.

GLP-1 receptor agonists (*1) not only help secrete insulin, which lowers blood sugar levels, but also suppress appetite, so they are attracting attention around the world as a treatment for obesity-related type 2 diabetes and obesity.

Quote:Therapeutic effects of GLP-1 receptor agonists and “habits in eating behavior” | Kyoto University Hospital

Therefore, what about beauty salons and self-made supplements?The legal position is clearly different。

Summary of 3 systems of medical diets
  • drug therapy: GLP-1 receptor agonist, etc. taken orally or by injection
  • Injection/treatment using equipment:Fat cooling using fat dissolving injections and medical equipment
  • surgical procedure: Liposuction (surgery)

The standard procedure is for the doctor to conduct an interview, blood test, and body composition measurement before the treatment, confirm the patient's chronic illness and medication status, and then decide on the treatment plan.

Since the treatment is carried out under the supervision of a doctor, we have a system in place to receive appropriate treatment should your physical condition change or side effects occur.

The types of treatments can be broadly divided into drug therapy by oral administration or injection, non-invasive treatment using medical equipment, and surgical liposuction.3 systemsThere is.

The type of strain you choose will depend on your weight, BMI, target area, budget, and lifestyle, so please consult with your doctor during counseling before deciding.

Self-help diets often lead to repeated rebounds due to a decline in basal metabolism and no change in the number of fat cells.

The reason behind repeated rebounds due to self-help dieting is that the bodydefensive reactionis deeply involved.

If you drastically reduce your calorie intake, your body will think you are in a state of starvation.lowers basal metabolism, adapted to sustain life with less energy.

If you suddenly return to your normal eating habits in this state, your energy intake may exceed your expended energy, making it easier to regain weight.

In addition, the number of fat cells is said to remain almost unchanged after adulthood, and dietary restrictions alone cannotAlthough fat cells can be made smaller,, the number cannot be reduced.

Two main reasons for repeated rebounds
  • Decreased basal metabolism:Due to extreme dietary restrictions, the body switches to energy-saving mode, and when eating is resumed, excess weight returns.
  • Unchanged fat cell number: Dietary restrictions can make fat cells smaller, but they cannot be reduced.

If you repeat extreme dietary restrictions, your muscle mass will decrease, your basal metabolism will further drop, and each time you rebound, you may find it difficult to lose weight.

The significance of medical intervention lies in breaking this vicious cycle with drugs and medical devices.

GLP-1 receptor agonists have the effect of suppressing appetite and prolonging the feeling of fullness, soIt may be easier to adjust the amount of food you eat。

Fat freezing and lipolytic injections are approaches that physically and chemically reduce fat cells in specific areas.

Even when using a medical diet, it is important to continue to manage your weight under the guidance of your doctor while reviewing your lifestyle habits such as diet and exercise.

Difference between when medical diets are covered by insurance and when you have to pay the entire amount out of pocket

Most medical diets are considered to be for beauty purposes, so they are not covered by health insurance.Full amount at own expenseIt becomes.

However, if obesity is accompanied by diseases such as high blood pressure, diabetes, or sleep apnea syndrome, some obesity treatment drugs may beCases covered by insuranceThere is.

Approved in Japan in 2023Semaglutide formulation(Ugobi) etc. are covered by insurance if certain conditions are met.

Reference:Partial revision of guidelines for promoting optimal use of semaglutide (genetically recombinant) preparations (obesity) | Japan Diabetes Society

The conditions for insurance coverage are strictly defined, and if the treatment is used for cosmetic purposes or does not meet the conditions, you will be required to pay for the treatment yourself. Please check with the clinic in advance.

On the other hand, all GLP-1 oral medications, fat-dissolving injections, fat cooling, medical EMS, etc. provided at beauty clinics areFree medical treatmentIt is treated as

Prices vary greatly depending on the type of treatment, number of times, and clinic; GLP-1 oral administration isFrom 10,000 yen per monthDepending on the area, liposuction can cost up to several hundred thousand yen.

5 points to check before choosing a medical diet clinic in Fukuoka

Failure to choose a clinic can have as much of an impact on results as failure to choose a procedure.

There are many clinics in Fukuoka City that provide medical diets.Fee structure, doctor's specialties, and support systemvaries greatly depending on the facility.

5 points to check when choosing a clinic
  • Check price transparency and any additional costs upfront
  • Check the qualifications of your doctor
  • Choose a clinic that is easy to visit in the Tenjin/Hakata area
  • Check the thoroughness of counseling and the after-sales support system
  • Choose a clinic that fully explains side effects and risks.

In order to experience the effects of the treatment, please prepare the following 5 points in advance before going to counseling.

Cost, doctor's specialty, location, quality of counseling・The honesty of risk explanations will affect continued hospital visits and satisfaction even if one of them is missing.

Please check each point in order to help you decide which clinic is right for you.

Check price transparency and any additional costs upfront

The most common problem with medical diet costs is that the amount is higher than the initial offer after counseling.significantly higher chargesThis is a case where this occurs.

Clinics that offer first-time limited prices or trial prices may have a structure in which the cost increases when you move on to a continuing course.

What you should check isBreakdown of total treatment costs, drug costs, re-examination fees, and test costsis clearly indicated.

Items to check when confirming costs
  • Is the breakdown of the total treatment cost, drug cost, re-examination fee, and test cost clearly stated?
  • Will the cost jump when moving from the initial limited price to the continuing course?
  • In the case of liposuction: Are there additional anesthesia fees, compression garment fees, and post-operative care fees?

Clinics that only display ``first time 〇〇 yen'' but don't give details are likely to incur additional costs, so be sure to ask for a written breakdown of costs at the time of your consultation.

In the case of GLP-1 therapy, the monthly fee varies depending on the type and dosage of the drug, so the criteria for making a decision is to check the total amount including maintenance period costs in advance.

Recently, the number of consultations regarding cosmetic medical problems has been increasing little by little, so you need to be careful.

We have received complaints about cosmetic medical treatments performed by doctors, such as laser hair removal, breast augmentation, liposuction, and circumcision, that have problems with their sales methods or advertising, or that they have suffered harm such as skin disorders or burns.

Quote:Aesthetic medical services (number and trends of various consultations) | National Consumer Affairs Center of Japan

Price transparency is the clinic'sThe first measure of honestyPlease use it as a.

Check the qualifications of your doctor

Medical diets are performed by doctorsmedical practiceTherefore, the field of expertise of the attending physician influences both credibility and results.

Clinics staffed by doctors with qualifications in plastic surgery, dermatology, and internal medicine tend to be more trustworthy when it comes to determining suitability for procedures and responding to complications.

When it comes to surgical procedures like liposuction, the amount of experience the surgeon has has a direct impact on the quality of the final result, so it is important to determine the surgeon's specialty.

Three points to determine a doctor's specialty
  • Qualifications/Responsible area: Reference qualifications related to plastic surgery, dermatology, and internal medicine
  • Politeness of interview: Is the suitability judgment based on pre-existing conditions and medication status?
  • Explanation of the reason for the treatment:Can you specifically explain why this treatment is suitable for you?

In many cases, qualifications in aesthetic medicine can be claimed if one has a medical license, and it is difficult to judge everything based solely on the presence or absence of qualifications. Use the academic qualifications as a reference.

GLP-1 therapy and fat-dissolving injections require judgment of suitability based on medical history and medication status.Determine whether the doctor's interview is thorough or not, as well as the doctor's specialty.This will give you a clue.

One of the things you should keep in mind when making your decision is whether the doctor can specifically explain why this treatment is suitable for you on the day of the consultation.

Choose a clinic that is easy to visit in the Tenjin/Hakata area

Many medical diets require multiple visits to the hospital, so the location of the clinicContinuation rateIt is directly connected to

GLP-1 therapy isMore than once a monthIt is common to visit a doctor, and fat-dissolving injections are a treatment that increases its effectiveness by repeating multiple sessions.

Tenjin/Hakata areaThe area has a concentration of JR, subway, and Nishitetsu lines, and is easily accessible not only from Fukuoka city but also from Kurume and Kitakyushu.

The less time it takes to visit the hospital, the lower the risk of interrupting the treatment midway through.Based on the time required from work or homeIt is a realistic method to narrow down the list of clinics.

Also check the range of treatment hours.

If the clinic is open on weekday nights or on weekends, it will be easier to schedule your visits to suit your work schedule.

Check the thoroughness of counseling and the after-sales support system

The quality of the initial counseling is an indicator of how well the clinic takes care of the post-procedure process.

A clinic that proposes a treatment after carefully listening to your weight, BMI, lifestyle habits, past diet history, etc.Responses tailored to individual conditionscan be expected.

On the other hand, clinics that start guiding you to a specific course immediately after your visit are more likely to be guided than counseling.Prioritize salesYou may have.

Regarding after-sales support, please check whether there is a consultation desk in case your physical condition changes or side effects occur after the treatment.

Clinics that have a system in place where you can consult about the progress after treatment on LINE or an app at any time can be said to be an environment where it is easy to continue treatment even if there is a gap between visits.

An important thing to check when comparing total costs is whether a follow-up consultation after the treatment is included in the cost.

Choose a clinic that fully explains side effects and risks.

There are varying degrees of medical diet treatments.Side effects and risksaccompanies.

GLP-1 therapy has been reported to cause nausea and loss of appetite, lipolysis injections have been reported to cause swelling and internal bleeding at the treatment site, and liposuction has been reported to cause postoperative contracture and infection risk.

A clinic that properly explains these risks in advance will also be able to deal with any problems that arise after the procedure.more likely to be honestIt is.

List of main risks and side effects by treatment
  • GLP-1 therapy: Nausea, loss of appetite, diarrhea, constipation
  • fat dissolving injection: Swelling, redness, and internal bleeding at the treatment site
